notes.title: A second update
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

Here's another update, this time a little bit more substantial:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]melee attacks were sometimes triggering twice[/b]
[*] [b]Crafting materials are now shared between the Stash and the Inventory while in the Hideout[/b], so the volunteer no longer needs to walk back and forth between the Stash and the Crafting Station
[*] [b]N60 rebalancing[/b]: damage (it scales with difficulty) increased from 55 to 66, reload time 2.9s->3.25s (buffed)
[*] [b]Micro Missiles rebalancing[/b]: damage (it scales with difficulty) decreased from 150 to 130, cooldown time 60s->90s (nerfed)
[*] [b]Neural Shield[/b]: radius increased from 16m to 25m (buffed), new sfx
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies hit at point-blank range by Micro Missiles would get an [b]absurdly long health bar :|[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue with [b]devices that sometimes were staying active after an extraction[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused [b]more than one Medikit to be consumed when crafting Adrenaline[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the [b]volunteer to freeze if dodging while extracting[/b]
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing some upgrades to ignore the [b]cooldown after a purchase[/b]. Now you'll notice that, for example, if you buy health++, you won't find it in the same area for some time (~30 minutes, but [b]cooldowns reset if you die[/b])
[*] Small typo (this->these)
[/list]

That's it for now!
[b]Thanks for all the feedback so far![/b]

notes.title: First small update
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

Quick update, mostly QoL. Here's the changelog:

[list]
[*] [b]Enemies activates when taking damage[/b]: sometimes it happened that an enemy couldn’t see the player, but the player was still able to hit them while remaining hidden
[*] Fixed some UIs when playing with a [b]16:10 resolution[/b]
[*] [b]Item weight is now visible in multiple views[/b] (stash, crafting stations, upgrades stations, drop/transfer dialog)
[*] The message "inventory full" was a little misleading, now it says "[b]weight limit reached[/b]"
[*] Fixed the description for the [b]"Firefighter" achievement[/b]
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when transferring crafting materials
[/list]

That's it, for now!
